events.title: Halloween Update: Haunted Harvest
events.summary: New twist: Haunted HarvestThe whole course is swallowed by a cornfield at night. One player becomes the hunter: bigger, faster, wearing a pumpkin and swinging a scythe. events.title: Next Fest Starts Tomorrow!
events.summary: Hey everyone! I Buried Steve is in Steam Next Fest, starting tomorrow! The free demo is live, so grab some friends and come build a beach that's actively trying to kill you. Wishlist GoalsThere's now a community wishlist track in the game. Every time we hit a goal, everyone gets a new reward: 1,000 wishlists: The Roundabout map. events.title: Secret Cards, Lobby Fishing & Seagull Spectators
events.summary: New FeaturesSecret Card – During drafting, you can now receive a secret card that other players can't see. Use it wisely. Lobby Fishing – Matches can take a moment to fill in a small indie game, so now you can fish while you wait. There are 20 unique fish to collect. Fish will also randomly jump out of the sea anywhere in the lobby – throw anything at them to catch them. Arcade Machine & Jarla – A mysterious arcade machine has appeared in spawn. events.title: The demo is out now
events.summary: Hey all, For the past couple of months I've been building I Buried Steve, and it's finally at the point where other people can play it.The idea is simple. Players take turns picking traps and blocks, and everyone builds a course that only they know how to finish. Then the countdown hits zero and all eight of you run it at once.
